aboutGame.title: What is Moonfrost?
paragraphs: Moonfrost is a cozy 2D pixel-art life-simulation RPG from indie studio Oxalis Games. You inherit an overgrown homestead and rebuild it into a thriving farm: tilling soil, planting seasonal crops, crafting tools and decor, and exploring a magical countryside shaped by day-night cycles and weather.

Beyond farming, Moonfrost layers in fishing, mining, workstation crafting, and a deep social system of villagers with daily schedules, gift preferences, romance routes, and community quests. Online co-op lets you build and explore the valley with friends while the game moves through its testing phases toward a full PC launch.

explore.title: Explore Moonfrost Guides
explore.description: Eight core Moonfrost topics covering everything from your first crops to system requirements, each with a quick preview and a full guide.

modules.name: Moonfrost Beginner Guide
modules.description: New player guidance covering the basics of farming, rebuilding the village, exploration, crafting, and early progression systems so beginners understand the core gameplay loop and their first steps.

highlights.detail: Clear a compact perimeter next to your cottage instead of deforesting the whole plot.
Speak with the nearby tutorial characters to claim your basic toolset.
Till unobstructed dirt with the hoe and plant short-cycle seeds like Quick-Sprout Radish.
Water every crop each day it does not rain, or its growth timer pauses.
Upgrade the watering can and hand axe first at the blacksmith for bigger capacity and hardwood access.
Explore town and meet villagers in short trips so you never run your stamina bar dry.

modules.name: Moonfrost Farming Guide
modules.description: Farming mechanics including land clearing, soil tilling, crop growing, irrigation, and harvesting, aimed at players building a productive homestead and planning seasonal harvests.

highlights.label: Radish
highlights.detail: Quick-Sprout Radish matures in 3 days and delivers fast early cash flow.

highlights.label: Berry

highlights.label: Greens

highlights.label: Blossom
highlights.detail: Golden Sun Blossom needs 7 days and sells for the highest early profit.

highlights.label: Grass
highlights.detail: Fibrous Field Grass is rain-fed and supplies feed plus crafting fiber.

highlights.label: Water
highlights.detail: Water planted tiles daily unless it rains, since growth only advances overnight.

modules.description: Crafting-related information including workstations, blueprint tiers, and the refining chains that turn raw materials into tools, decorations, outfits, and collectibles.

highlights.label: Sawn Planks

highlights.label: Cured Beams
highlights.detail: Turn 4 Hardwood Chunks into 1 beam for barn frames and tool handles.

highlights.label: Copper Bars
highlights.detail: Smelt 5 Copper Ore plus 1 charcoal into a bar for Tier-1 tool upgrades.

highlights.label: Iron Ingots

highlights.label: Braided Twine
highlights.detail: Spin 4 Wild Plant Fibers into twine for backpacks, tackle, and sailcloth.

highlights.label: Fired Bricks
highlights.detail: Fire 2 Clay plus 1 kindling into bricks for wells and pathways.

modules.name: Moonfrost Building Guide
modules.description: Home customization, building systems, decorations, and village restoration, helping players planning house design, construction, and efficient homestead layouts.

highlights.detail: Clear stumps, rocks, and weeds from the footprint before placing any blueprint.
Snap structures to the grid so paths, fences, and landmarks stay aligned.
Gather standard timber for basic fences, framing, and simple crates.
Process planks and hardwood beams for sturdy walls, roofs, and barn rafters.
Refine stone and kiln-fired bricks for foundations, wells, and chimneys.
Keep crafting stations near the main cottage to cut travel and stamina costs.

modules.name: Moonfrost System Requirements
modules.description: PC requirements, platform details, and availability information for players checking whether their device can run Moonfrost on Steam or Epic.

highlights.label: OS
highlights.detail: Windows 10 (64-bit) minimum; Windows 11 (64-bit) recommended.

highlights.label: CPU
highlights.detail: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300 minimum; Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 recommended.

highlights.label: RAM
highlights.detail: 8 GB minimum; 16 GB recommended.

highlights.label: GPU
highlights.detail: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X minimum; GTX 1660 / RX 5600 XT recommended.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 6 GB free space minimum with an SSD recommended; 10 GB on NVMe recommended.

highlights.label: FPS
highlights.detail: Targets 60 FPS with uncapped framerates up to 144+ on desktop.

faq.title: Moonfrost FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Moonfrost.

items.question: What is Moonfrost?
items.answer: Moonfrost is a cozy 2D pixel-art life-simulation RPG from indie studio Oxalis Games. You rebuild an overgrown homestead by farming crops, crafting tools, fishing, and befriending the villagers of a magical valley.

items.question: Is Moonfrost multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Moonfrost supports online co-op, so you can build, farm, and explore the valley together with friends.

items.question: What platforms is Moonfrost on?
items.answer: Moonfrost is being built for PC, with Steam and Epic storefronts and limited playtest builds released ahead of the full 1.0 launch.

items.question: How do I start in Moonfrost?
items.answer: Clear a small area near your cottage, claim your starter tools, plant fast-maturing seeds like Quick-Sprout Radish, and water crops every day they do not receive rain.

items.question: Do I need to manage stamina in Moonfrost?
items.answer: Yes. Every axe, hoe, and pickaxe swing drains stamina in Moonfrost, and running out slows your character or makes them faint, so plan each day carefully.

items.question: Can I romance villagers in Moonfrost?
items.answer: Moonfrost includes a romance system built on daily conversations, loved gifts, festival visits, and milestone heart events with each candidate.
